summary: The PR addresses the issue of the caplog fixture not restoring the log level after a test, but there are some minor concerns regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any additional tests to verify that the log handler level is correctly restored. While the existing tests pass, more specific tests should be added to ensure this functionality.
There is no update to the documentation to reflect the change in behavior or the fix applied. The documentation should be updated to clarify that the log handler level is now also restored.
